summary: United Launch Alliance has traced a recent Vulcan Centaur rocket failure to an inadequate fuel supply to its first-stage engines, an anomaly that occurred shortly after liftoff, destroyed 40 Amazon satellites, and raised strategic implications for future Pentagon launches. In defense space news, the U.S. Senate backed plans to enlarge the Space Force while trimming broader defense budgets, NATO inaugurated an 11-nation satellite launch initiative called Starlift, and Finnish satellite company ICEYE submitted a €2 billion acquisition offer for Italian rocket manufacturer Avio. In civil space and scientific research, NASA's interstellar Voyager 1 probe officially reached the landmark distance of one light-day from Earth, researchers leveraging NASA data confirmed a first-of-its-kind stellar merger, and atmospheric measurements from the Curiosity rover indicated potential trace amounts of surface water on Mars. Commercial sector developments included Ramon.Space securing $124 million in Series B funding, Space Cargo Unlimited unveiling its REV1 reentry vehicle, and Inflection Space Systems booking its inaugural orbital mission. Looking ahead, observers should watch for the planned launch of Reflect Orbital’s first sunlight-reflecting mirror satellite next year.
